Topology.title: Azure Hub-Spoke Network
Topology.Description: A hub-and-spoke Azure network with centralized security and management.
Topology.Summary: The hub contains an Azure Firewall and Azure Bastion. Spokes are VNETs for identity, operations, and workloads, with all inter-spoke traffic routed through the hub firewall.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n12) in the 'Asset Management' zone (z8), which is managed and monitored by the 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3).

Control.title: Document Data Flows
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation' server (n13) in the 'Documentation' zone (z9), which is managed and monitored by the 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3).

Control.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple VNETs (z2, z3, z4, z6) for different purposes (Identity, Operations, Workload, Non-Production), which are peered with the Hub VNet (z1) and route traffic through the Azure Firewall (n1).

Control.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Firewall' (n1) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which manages traffic between the hub and spokes.

Control.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n4) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is managed by the 'Azure Firewall' (n1).

Control.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA/Identity Server' (n5) in the 'Management VNet' (z5), which is managed by the 'Azure Bastion' (n2).

Control.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Service' (n14) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is connected to the 'DNS Server' (n4).

Control.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n6) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is connected to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1).

Control.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a hub-and-spoke design with a central 'Azure Firewall' (n1) and multiple VNETs (z2, z3, z4, z6) for different purposes, which are peered with the 'Hub VNet' (z1).

Control.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Repository' (n15) in the 'Management VNet' (z5), which is managed by the 'Azure Firewall' (n1).

Control.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA/Identity Server' (n5) in the 'Management VNet' (z5), which is managed by the 'Azure Bastion' (n2).

Control.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Bastion' (n2) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is used for remote access and is managed by the 'MFA/Identity Server' (n5).

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' (n11) in the 'Management VNet' (z5), which is managed by the 'Azure Bastion' (n2).

Control.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n7) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is monitored by the 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3).

Control.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Firewall' (n1) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which routes and filters traffic between the hub and spokes (z2, z3, z4, z6).

Control.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA/Identity Server' (n5) in the 'Management VNet' (z5), which is managed by the 'Azure Bastion' (n2).

Control.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which collects logs from the 'Azure Firewall' (n1).

Control.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS' (n8) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is monitored by the 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3).

Control.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'NAC' (n10) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is managed by the 'Azure Firewall' (n1).

Control.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' (n9) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1), which is connected to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1).

Control.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production VNet' (z6) which is peered with the 'Hub VNet' (z1) and is separate from the other VNETs (z2, z3, z4).

Control.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Pen Testing Service' (n17) in the 'Pen Testing' zone (z10), which is connected to the 'Azure Firewall' (n1).
